gold_rationale: iPSC-derived midbrain DA neurons with correct identity (TH/NURR1/PITX3), floor-plate lineage (FOXA2/LMX1A), undetectable residual pluripotency, and demonstrated dopamine release are a promising product. Progression to preclinical translation should be conditional on in vivo engraftment/survival data, formal tumorigenicity studies, batch reproducibility, and defined potency/release criteria. Encouraging characterization is not a fully de-risked product.
red_flags: declares the product clinically ready without in vivo or tumorigenicity data
ignores graft survival or potency/release criteria
